postdate.definition:
v. be later in time
v. establish something as being later relative to something else
postdate.translation:
vt. 填迟...的日期
n. 事后日期

postdated.translation: v. 填迟…的日期( postdate的过去式和过去分词 )

postdates.definition:
v be later in time
v establish something as being later relative to something else
postdates.translation: v. 填迟…的日期( postdate的第三人称单数 )

postdating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Postdate
postdating.translation: v. 填迟…的日期( postdate的现在分词 )

postdental.translation: 齿后音, 后齿音, 齿槽音

postdiluvian.definition:
n. anything living after Noah's flood
a. existing or occurring after Noah's flood

postdoc.definition: n. a scholar or researcher who is involved in academic study beyond the level of a doctoral degree

postdoctoral.definition:
n. a grant that funds postdoctoral study or research
a. of or relating to study or research that is done after work for the doctoral degree has been completed

postdoctorals.definition:
plural of postdoctoral
n. a grant that funds postdoctoral study or research
a. of or relating to study or research that is done after work for the doctoral degree has been completed
postdoctorals.translation: (postdoctoral 的复数) a. 博士后的

postdoctorate.translation:
n. 博士后研究人员
a. 博士学位取得后的
